newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.59 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.59 pct in July.

text.p: Brazil's real closed at 1.0830 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market, unchanged on the day, but down 0.59 percent for the month, dealers said.

Earlier Thursday, the Central Bank depreciated the mini- band by 0.09 percent to between 1.0830 and 1.0880 reais per dollar. The mini-band fell 0.60 percent during July, compared with a 0.61 drop in June.
This year, monthly declines in the mini-band have ranged from 0.57 percent to 0.61 percent.

The real was supported by banks holding dollars over the last few days for sale on Thursday. The Thursday closing prices in the futures market will be used for August contract settlements on Friday, dealers said.
The Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0830 per greenback late in the afternoon.

In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0885 per greenback, down 0.05 percent on the day and 0.61 percent for the month. In the parallel market, the real closed at 1.147 per dollar, up 0.26 percent against Wednesday's close, but 1.06 percent down from June.
